<!-- pr-reviewer: aa71381e8b0d21797e08e9cb1b791a1f2135ed30 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** This is the first review of this PR. It is a docs-only PR. It is not a SAFETY-tier review: the diff changes no posted G-code, no check, no simulation and no geometry.

## What looks good

- The diff adds one file, `site/content/developers/ai-agents.md` (152 lines, 2 commits). It changes no code, no test, no golden and no process file.
- The page says that `AGENTS.md` is correct where the two differ (lines 10-12).
- `weight = 5` puts the page after Releases (`weight = 4`) in the Developers section. No other page of the section has this weight.
- The internal link `@/guide/automate/ai.md` (line 54) points to a file that exists.
- The Discord link is the same link that `README.md` and `windows-troubleshooting.md` already use.
- The page has no machine names, no accounts and no private details.
- The Linux packages in "Your first hour" (lines 24-26) are the same packages that `.github/workflows/release.yml` installs.
- The skills that the page names (`/work-issue`, `/gh-issues`, `/review-prs`, `/gate`, `/fork-sync`) exist in `.claude/skills/`.
- The statements that I compared with `AGENTS.md` of `upstream/main` agree with it: the claim by comment, `P?`, one branch for each issue, the pinning test, `cargo xtask gate quick --base main`, the draft PR, the `Changelog:` line, `Fixes #N` / `Refs #N`, `Process change: yes`, the reason for a new top-level test binary, no force-push, the refresh at merge time, never `CARGO_TARGET_DIR`, and the LF rule in `.gitattributes`.

## Results merged with main

Built and tested locally, in the worktree of the review. `upstream/main` is `02bf65d93`. The head moved from `ada3b04ef` to `aa71381e8` during the review. I read the two commits. All results below are for `aa71381e8` merged with `02bf65d93`.

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| Trial merge with `upstream/main` | clean, no conflict |
| `python3 -m unittest discover -s site/tests` on the trial merge | 104 tests: 95 pass, 1 failure, 8 errors |
| The same command on bare `upstream/main` (`02bf65d93`) | 104 tests: 95 pass, the same 1 failure, the same 8 errors |
| Zola build tests in that suite (`test_guide_navigation`, `test_guide_images`, the build test of `test_guide_icons`, `test_operation_reference`, `test_windows_troubleshooting`) | pass: the site builds with the new page and the internal link resolves |
| Cargo build, quick gate, clippy | not run: the diff has no Rust code |
| Light lane, heavy lanes, `example_catalog` | not run: the diff does not reach them |

The 9 red results are not caused by this PR. They are the same on bare `upstream/main`:

```
ERROR: test_first_4axis_part ... test_each_bold_ui_label_is_a_string_in_its_source (label='New tool…')
ERROR: test_first_continuous_4axis_part ... test_each_bold_ui_label_is_a_string_in_its_source (label='New tool…')
  FileNotFoundError: .../crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_library.rs
ERROR: test_search_query (6 subtests)
  FileNotFoundError: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: 'node'
FAIL: test_guide_icons ... test_component_static_icons_and_license_match_app
  AssertionError: site_notice != app_notice
```

- The 6 `test_search_query` errors are from this host: it has no `node`.
- The 2 label errors and the 1 icon notice failure are red on `main`. I did not find an issue that tracks them. #3764 ("run the site tests before a cut") is related.

Extra suites run: none. The diff has no file under `testdata/` and no importer code.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Optional, non-blocking

1. `site/content/developers/ai-agents.md:87-88` - "merged by a maintainer or the merge bot". `AGENTS.md` has no merge bot. The maintainer merges an outside PR by hand, and a collaborator's session merges a collaborator's PR through `/merge-ready`.
2. `site/content/developers/ai-agents.md:100` - "Remove a worktree once its PR merges". `AGENTS.md` says "Remove a worktree when its PR is pushed".
3. `site/content/developers/ai-agents.md:98` - "10-25 GB". `AGENTS.md` says that one `target/` is 10-20 GB.
4. `site/content/developers/ai-agents.md:77-78` - the page says that reviewers ask for before/after screenshots on an images-only fork branch. `AGENTS.md` and the skills of `upstream/main` do not have this rule. The maintainer can decide if the page keeps it or if `AGENTS.md` gets it.
5. `site/content/developers/ai-agents.md:35-36` - the link text says "P3/P7 bugs", but the search has no priority filter. It also does not exclude `blocked`, `needs-research` and `P?` issues. A new contributor can open a paused issue from this list.
6. The PR body does not name the "Your first hour" section of the second commit.
7. The PR body has `Refs #3909`. Issue #3909 lists the user guide items for v0.27.0, and this page is not one of them. The commit bodies have no `Refs` line. This does not block a docs-only PR, because `Refs` closes nothing.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 282f216b280da773097369fe2fa68a39baf68005 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** The PR adds one developer guide page. The page builds, appears after Releases, and links to the AI and automation guide.

## Earlier review

The review of `aa71381e8` had no requested changes. I checked all seven optional notes:

1. Fixed. Line 98 now says that maintainers merge the PR.
2. Still applies. Lines 116 and 294 say to remove the worktree after merge. Upstream `AGENTS.md` says to remove it after push.
3. Still applies. Line 114 gives 10–25 GB. Upstream `AGENTS.md` gives 10–20 GB for one target directory.
4. No longer applies. The before-and-after screenshot instructions agree with the current review requirements.
5. Still applies. The starter issue query on line 43 omits the priority filter and can include paused or blocked issues.
6. Fixed. The PR body now describes “Your first hour.”
7. Still applies. `Refs #3909` is informational. The checklist in #3909 does not list this page.

## Results merged with main

I tested locally on macOS. The trial merge with upstream main at `32437cd79` succeeded. Its first parent was the PR head.

- `zola build` passed. Zola built 51 pages and 10 sections, with zero orphan pages.
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s site/tests` ran 104 tests on the trial merge and again on bare upstream main. Both runs had 101 passes, one failure, and two errors.
- The icon license test `test_component_static_icons_and_license_match_app` has the same notice mismatch on both trees. The two 4-axis guide tests for “New tool…” both refer to the same missing `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_library.rs` on both trees. The prior review found no issue that tracks these specific failures. #3764 tracks running site tests before a cut.
- `git diff --check` passed. The diff reaches only the developer guide. Cargo, quick gate, clippy, and the heavy lanes were outside the changed area.

Extra suites run: none. The diff changes no fixtures or importers. The diff also changes no posted output, collision checks, stock simulation, or geometry. No safety mutations apply.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Optional, non-blocking

- `site/content/developers/ai-agents.md:52` could name Claude Code v2.1.277 as the minimum version for automatic `AGENTS.md` loading and mention the effect of a local `CLAUDE.md`. [Claude Code project instructions](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory#agentsmd)
- `site/content/developers/ai-agents.md:279` could describe how review and tests reduce risk. They cannot guarantee that every defect is caught before a program reaches a machine.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
